fullPassage: One of the most difficult conditions that patients deal with after a stroke is called "hemispatial neglect." This occurs when there is damage to the brain's parietal lobe, which helps process sensory information. When it is damaged, patients cannot perceive people, sounds, and objects on one side of their body. Each of the brain's hemispheres controls the other side of the body, so patients cannot sense what is on the opposite side of the brain damage. For example, a man with damage to the left side of the brain cannot perceive what is on the right. As a result, he might only shave the left side of his face. Similarly, what if a woman suffering from damage to the right side of the brain put on makeup? She would only apply it to the right side of her face.

questions.passage: When the brain's parietal lobe ①<u>are</u> damaged, patients cannot notice things on one side of their body. Each hemisphere ②<u>controls</u> the opposite side of the body. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: are → is (주어 the brain's parietal lobe가 단수이므로 단수동사 is)
det.analysis:
① are: 'the brain's parietal lobe ___ damaged'에서 주어는 단수 lobe(두정엽 하나)예요. 단수 주어에는 단수동사가 오므로 'is damaged'가 맞아요. are는 복수동사라 틀려요. ←정답
② controls: 'Each hemisphere ___'에서 주어 Each hemisphere는 단수라 단수동사 controls가 맞아요. 적절합니다.
③ shaves: 'a man ___ only the left side'에서 주어 a man은 3인칭 단수라 동사에 -s가 붙은 shaves가 맞아요. 적절합니다.
④ suffering: 'A woman ___ from right-brain damage puts ~'에서 본동사는 puts이고, 앞부분은 woman을 꾸미는 현재분사라 suffering이 맞아요. 적절합니다.
det.tip: 단수 주어(parietal lobe) → 단수동사 is. are(X)

questions.passage: One of the most difficult conditions that patients deal with after a stroke is called "hemispatial neglect." This occurs when there is damage to the brain's parietal lobe, which helps process sensory information. When it is damaged, patients cannot perceive people, sounds, and objects on one side of their body. Each of the brain's hemispheres controls the other side of the body, so patients cannot sense what is on the opposite side of the brain damage. For example, a man with damage to the left side of the brain cannot perceive what is on the right. As a result, he might only shave the left side of his face. Similarly, what if a woman suffering from damage to the right side of the brain put on makeup? She would only apply it to the right side of her face.

det.tip: 두정엽의 역할 = process(처리하다) sensory(감각의) information(정보)

det.analysis: damage를 과거분사 damaged로 변환해요. 'the parietal lobe is damaged'는 '두정엽이 손상되다'라는 수동태예요. 「be동사(is) + 과거분사(damaged)」로 '~되다'라는 수동의 뜻을 만들어요. 두정엽이 스스로 손상시키는 게 아니라 '손상을 당하는' 것이므로 수동태가 맞아요.
det.tip: is __________ = 수동태(be + 과거분사) → damage의 과거분사 damaged

questions.stem:

'환자들은 반대편에 무엇이 있는지 감지하지 못한다'
[조건] (1) cannot, is, on, opposite, patients, sense, side, the, what을 모두 사용

det.korean: patients cannot sense what is on the opposite side = 환자들은 반대편에 무엇이 있는지 감지하지 못한다
det.analysis:
먼저 주어와 동사 'patients cannot sense(환자들은 감지하지 못한다)'를 놓아요. cannot 뒤에는 동사원형 sense가 와요.

'무엇이 반대편에 있는지'는 「what + 주어·동사」 형태의 명사절이에요. 여기서 what은 '~하는 것/무엇'을 뜻하며 뒤에 'is on the opposite side(반대편에 있다)'가 이어져요.

순서: patients + cannot + sense + what + is + on + the + opposite + side.
det.tip: cannot + 동사원형(sense) / what + is on ~ = '~에 있는 것'이라는 명사절
